paragraphs.text: Secrets of Strixhaven is the 111th Magic: The Gathering expansion . It features a return to Strixhaven University on the plane of Arcavios , and was released on April 24, 2026. The set spotlights more of the world outside the school than Strixhaven: School of Mages did, although it is still set primarily at Strixhaven. The set is Standard legal.
Like its predecessor, the theme of the set is the magical school trope .

The main Standard -legal set uses the code SOS. It contains 281 regular cards (86 commons, 100 uncommons, 60 rares, 20 mythic rares, 15 basic lands) , and includes randomly inserted traditional foil versions of all cards. Alternate card frames have a different card number than the original version.
The related non-Standard code is SOC ( Secrets of Strixhaven Commander ); these cards are legal in Commander , Legacy , and Vintage , and reprints remain legal where already legal.
↑ The cards with the numbers 154, 189, 211, 277, 359 & 426 are missing from the set.
The related bonus sheet code is SOA ( Secrets of Strixhaven Mystical Archive ); with the same legality as SOC.

Secrets of Strixhaven features ten Special Guests that depict lectures from the halls of Strixhaven University . Each card showcases the varied and vibrant curriculum of the campus. Non-foil Special Guests cards can be found in Play Boosters and traditional foil Special Guests cards in Collector Boosters . These cards may be played in Limited games but are otherwise only legal in sets where the card is already legal.

On Magic: The Gathering Arena , Library of Leng is replaced with the Reserved List card Library of Alexandria , which features exclusive new art by Bruce Brenneise . Ian Adams explained the change in terms of user experience, with Library of Leng creating negative experiences through the double handling of first choosing the discard order for the cards and then having to choose which destination (graveyard or library) each card goes to individually. By contrast, the Library of Alexandria has a very simple user experience and is a Powered Cube card that is newly craftable.
The implementation of Sylvan Library posed a challenge to the MTG Arena design team.

Secrets of Strixhaven features Play Boosters , Collector Boosters , a Draft Night box, a Bundle , a limited-edition "Codex Bundle", and five preconstructed Commander decks . The set also features a Mystical Archive bonus sheet , similar to the original Mystical Archive .

Secrets of Strixhaven Play Boosters contain 14 playing cards and 1 non-foil punch-out card or double-sided token. A Play Booster box contains 30 packs. Collector Boosters 15 cards plus 1 art card or traditional foil double-sided token. A Collector Booster box includes 12 packs. All cards opened in Secrets of Strixhaven Play Boosters are legal for play in Draft and Sealed , including the Mystical Archive and Special Guests cards related to the set. Five preconstructed Commander decks are released alongside the main set.

Two preconstructed Theme Decks are released alongside the main set. These are 60-card, Standard -legal decks, one themed around Lifegain and the other around Enchantments . They're designed to introduce players to Constructed formats, and to play well against other Theme Decks. The flavor of the decks is not specific to Arcavios; they include cards from across Standard.
Secrets of Strixhaven features five Welcome Decks .

There is also a punch card with " Prepared " markers.

Like in Strixhaven: School of Mages , instant and sorcery spells are a major mechanical throughline of Secrets of Strixhaven . In keeping with this, the set introduces preparation cards . Prepare is a designation that appears on creatures with a "prepare spell," which appears on the right side of their text box in a similar way to Adventures . Creatures with prepare spells have different conditions to become prepared. While a creature is prepared, you can cast a copy of its prepare spell by paying its mana cost, after which it becomes unprepared.
Each of the colleges has an associated ability word or keyword ability , most of which are introduced in this set:
Silverquill ( ) cards feature Repartee . Repartee abilities appear on creatures and trigger whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell that targets a creature.
Prismari ( ) cards feature Opus . Opus abilities trigger whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, and have an additional effect if you spent five or more mana to cast it.
Witherbloom ( ) cards feature Infusion . Infusion signifies abilities that care if you have gained life this turn.
Lorehold ( ) cards feature the returning Flashback . Flashback is an alternate cost for instant and sorcery spells that allows them to be cast from your graveyard once.

Quandrix ( ) cards feature Increment . Similar to evolve in concept, increment appears on creatures, and causes their controller to put a +1/+1 counter on them whenever they pay an amount of mana greater than the creature's power or toughness to cast a spell.

Converge returns from Battle for Zendikar , representing the power of the Archaics . Spells with converge care about the number of colors of mana spent to cast them. Some of these cards have two-brid mana in their costs to make them more versatile.

The new Paradigm mechanic appears on one cycle of spells at mythic rare . It is most reminiscent of epic , in that it allows a single massive spell to have an impact on the rest of the game. After a spell with paradigm resolves, you exile it, and for the rest of the game, you can cast a copy of it without paying its mana cost at the beginning of each of your turns.
Cameo mechanics used in the set include casualty , storm , miracle , cascade , affinity , and Grandeur .

Cards associated with one of the Colleges feature their symbol as a watermark . Ral Zarek, Guest Lecturer features a unique watermark in the shape of Jace Beleren 's sigil ( ). This was later revealed to be the Echoverse sigil that is also featured in Reality Fracture .

Secrets of Strixhaven introduces the Giraffe creature type and the Book artifact type . However, the set does not contain any cards that reference or interact with the Book type. Nearly 50 existing cards and tokens received errata to gain the Book type.
The set features the first Dellian planeswalker, as well as the first Ral not to be both blue and red.
The Lesson spell type returns on one cycle of cards with Paradigm. However, the associated learn mechanic doesn't return in this set.
Exceptionally, Secrets of Strixhaven doesn't feature either Equipment or Auras .
The set uses page counters , first seen in Urza's Saga , on a Book .

Secrets of Strixhaven features the following five limited archetypes . Note that with Converge, three color combinations ( wedges consisting of two enemy pairs) are also intended to be viable archetypes.
( Silverquill ): Repartee Aggro
( Prismari ): Opus Spellcasting
( Witherbloom ): Lifegain Swarm
( Lorehold ): Flashback Excavation
( Quandrix ): Incremental Value
In the Secrets of Strixhaven rules update, Sneak received a small wording tweak to better define the cast permission it provides.

Sagas also received a small change, to better match the mechanism that adds lore counters to planeswalkers and battles. Specifically, the ability that causes Sagas to enter with lore counters on them was made an intrinsic ability. This also applies to the ability that allows the controller of Sagas with read ahead to choose a number of lore counters.

Killian Lu , Dina , Rootha Squallheart , and other returning characters are now recent graduates of Strixhaven University, putting their magic to practice in the wider world. The set also features five new students just choosing their colleges : Lluwen , Abigale , Sanar , Tam , Kirol . The school and the students are confronted by the Archaics , who have been provoked into a destructive rampage. Chandra Nalaar joins up with a group of reformed Oriq , while an alternate form of Ral Zarek causes trouble. A new planeswalker, Professor Dellian Fel , also has his own objectives.

Separate from the main storyline, the young-adult novel Omens of Chaos , by Seanan McGuire , tells the story of Strixhaven's first class of interplanar students, who have traveled to Arcavios via Omenpaths .

A return to Arcavios was first teased during the 2023 Announcement Day panel at Gen Con Indiana. The name Secrets of Strixhaven was announced at MagicCon : Las Vegas 2025, with more details given at MagicCon: Atlanta 2025.

Three months before the release of the set, a scrap worker leaked pictures of metal printing plates for its Prismari Commander deck . The pictures show cards partway through the printing process, with art and text on different plates.

The Headliner for this set is Emeritus of Ideation , which features a serialized version (#1–500) with art by Mark Poole and a throwback-styled, textless frame . Because it is textless, it also misses the Ancestral Recall part.

Secrets of Strixhaven is currently the bestselling in-Multiverse premier set in Magic history, outselling the previous record holder, Lorwyn Eclipsed , by a significant margin. The set also had the most highly attended Prerelease since War of the Spark .
